verdict.rationale: Warp is an HR and payroll platform, so cancelling or correcting a submitted payroll run is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never documents voiding, cancelling, reversing or editing a submitted payroll before employees are paid. It only shows general payroll automation by Warp Agent, plus API, webhook and benefit-deduction features, none of which are this capability.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can cancel or correct a submitted payroll before employees are paid
